result:
**Qualified acceptance: the metadata supports a VALID completed cold ABBA with a quality/efficiency trade-off. The performance screen fails; default adoption and vendor-win claims remain unsupported.**

I found no material contradiction in the checked bindings. All four native reports match their independent expected identity/input templates; runtime and reducer config hashes agree with supervision; report and publication-proof hashes match cell terminals. All 16 native stages closed successfully. The frozen source requires create-only publication with each cell terminal uploaded last before starting the next cell; the successful chain and publication receipts support that chronology. See [stages.tsv](/data/target/borsuk-source-shortlist-library.pending/launch-cold-v9-a0003/collected/evidence/stages.tsv) and [root-verification.json](/data/target/borsuk-source-shortlist-library.pending/launch-cold-v9-a0003/root-verification.json).

Completed native aggregates report:

| Cell | Hits / 10,000 | p90 ms | p95 ms | Sequential QPS |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| A1 | 9,780 | 206.311 | 268.234 | 5.352 |
| B1 | 9,786 | 240.420 | 309.778 | 5.470 |
| B2 | 9,786 | 235.887 | 308.932 | 5.510 |
| A2 | 9,780 | 202.136 | 228.028 | 5.327 |

Every cell completed 1,000 queries with zero underfills. Both controls reproduce the anchor; both candidates exceed the target and floor. Candidate paired p90 regresses **16.53% / 16.70%**, and p95 regresses **15.49% / 35.48%**, despite QPS improving **2.22% / 3.43%**. Those values agree with [abba-summary.json](/data/target/borsuk-source-shortlist-library.pending/launch-cold-v9-a0003/collected/results/abba-summary.json).

Retain the candidate’s quality and logical-I/O gains: per cell, SQ8 saves **1,545 GETs and 5,211,196,032 verified bytes**; SOURCE charges remain unchanged. Candidate process peaks increase to 92.8–100.4 MB from 75.3–78.0 MB. This is useful Pareto evidence across selected objectives, not overall dominance.

Resource snapshots show CPU 0, 100% CPU quota, 2 GiB, zero swap, 128-task limits and no OOM events. Cleanup receipts show the Spot instance terminated, volume absent and external timer inactive. The terminal’s `compute_closure_pending:true` is an earlier publication state superseded by [compute.closed](/data/target/borsuk-source-shortlist-library.pending/launch-cold-v9-a0003/compute.closed) and final receipts.

**One next plan:** preserve this disposition and investigate SQ8 tail behavior before further adoption work. Native SQ8 p95 worsens from **80.23/73.80 ms** to **109.42/108.20 ms**, while its median improves; planning stays near 31 ms. B1 also has a SOURCE-tail excursion that B2 does not reproduce. Stage percentiles cannot identify which queries caused the overall tail.

**Bounded falsifier, proposed only:** after root authorization and admission gates, use the existing pinned `diagnostic_panel` path on 64 predetermined, evenly spaced ordinals, candidate trace off/on, with unchanged generation, budgets and width. Cap each cell at 60 seconds under the original resource limits. Test whether elevated SQ8 intervals track range-fetch waits rather than ranking work or scheduling pressure. Reject that explanation if the decomposition disagrees; reject the diagnostic if tracing materially changes behavior. This panel would guide investigation, not qualify population tails.

No files changed, scientific bodies opened, statistics recomputed, builds or experiments run; archive authentication relies on the supplied root receipt. Server-cache coldness, billed cost, concurrent-service performance and causal attribution between the two complete configurations remain unqualified.
